defect_location.notes: CVE-2021-23017: nginx resolver 差一错误（CVE 描述: an attacker who is able to forge UDP packets from the DNS server to cause 1-byte memory overwrite, CWE-193）。

source.simplification: 剥离 nginx DNS 解析器与网络层，保留『名字解压时 '.' 偏移差一 → 1 字节越界写』核心缺陷（与官方描述 CWE-193 off-by-one 一致）

trigger_condition: crafted DNS 名总长恰等于目的缓冲大小 → 终止符写到 dst[cap]
